lobe_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
saddle_height = 20.0           # overall height of the curved saddle
dome_radius = 112.0            # radius of the shallow spherical dome crown
pocket_depth = 17.0            # hexagonal pocket depth (from the top face)
pocket_circumradius = 20.0     # hexagon circumradius (across corners)
through_hole_diameter = 22.4   # central through hole (M22 tap drill size)

# ---------------- derived geometry ----------------
# centre of the spherical crown (dome)

with BuildPart() as p:
    # 1) outer hexagonal profile (six lobes) at the base
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        RegularPolygon(lobe_radius, 6)
    # 2) same hexagon carried up to the crown plane
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(crown_z)):
        RegularPolygon(lobe_radius, 6)
    # 3) shallow spherical dome crown (spherical surface)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(crown_z)):

    loft()

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(saddle_height)):
        RegularPolygon(pocket_circumradius, 6)
    extrude(amount=-pocket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 5) central through hole
    with Locations((0.0, 0.0, saddle_height / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(through_hole_diameter / 2.0, saddle_height + 40.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # 6) chamfer the vertical outer edges
    chamfer(p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), edge_chamfer)

# ---------------- dimensions (mm) ----------------
outer_radius      = 40.0        # radius of the 4 corner lobes
inner_radius      = 12.0        # radius of the through bore
thickness         = 20.0        # base plate thickness

hex_corner_radius = 21.0        # circumscribed radius of the hexagonal pocket
hex_depth         = 15.0        # depth of the hexagonal pocket (from top face)

fillet_radius     = 1.0         # small fillet on the vertical edges

# ---------------- geometry ----------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- base plate: four lobes joined by a smooth concave waist ----
    with BuildSketch() as outline:
        # four corner lobes
        with Locations((outer_radius, 0), (0, outer_radius),
                       (-outer_radius, 0), (0, -outer_radius)):
            Circle(outer_radius)

        # concave waist: single arc between adjacent lobes, rotated to all 4 gaps
        with PolarLocations(inner_radius, 4, start_angle=45):
            ThreePointArc(
                (inner_radius, 0),
                (inner_radius * 0.6, inner_radius * 0.6),
                (0, inner_radius),
            )

        # small central through bore
        Circle(inner_radius, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # extrude to thickness, then dome the top slightly (convex crown)
    extrude(amount=thickness)
    top_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    with BuildSketch(top_face) as crown_sk:
        Circle(outer_radius)
    loft(amount=1.0, target=crown_sk.sketch)

    # ---- hexagonal pocket cut from the top ----
    top_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    with BuildSketch(top_face) as hex_sk:
        RegularPolygon(hex_corner_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=-hex_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    fillet(vertical_edges, fillet_radius)

from build123d import *

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
bracket_length = 80.0          # overall length of the bracket (Z)
bracket_width = 60.0           # overall width (X)
bracket_height = 17.0           # overall height (Y)
wall_thickness = 3.0           # thin uniform wall
corner_radius = 8.0            # rounded outer corners

slot_length = 64.0             # through-slot length (Z)
slot_width = 12.0              # through-slot width (X)
slot_spacing = 22.0            # centre distance between the three slots
n_slots = 3

boss_diameter = 13.9           # tapped boss diameter
boss_depth = 9.5               # boss depth from the top face
boss_hole_diameter = 9.0       # tap drill diameter
boss_hole_depth = 7.0          # blind tapped hole depth
boss_z = bracket_length / 2.0  # bosses sit at mid length

chamfer_distance = 1.0         # edge break on the boss rim


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as bracket:
    # --- outer body: obround (slot-shaped) cross-section swept along Z -----
    with BuildSketch() as outer_sketch:
        SlotOverall(bracket_width, bracket_height)
    extrude(amount=bracket_length)

    # --- hollow the body to a uniform thin wall -----------------------------
    offset(amount=-wall_thickness, openings=bracket.faces())

    # --- three through slots ------------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(bracket_length)) as slot_sketch:
        with GridLocations(slot_spacing, 0, n_slots, 1):
            SlotOverall(slot_width, slot_length)
    extrude(amount=-bracket_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- three tapped bosses on the top face -------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(bracket_length)) as boss_sketch:
        with GridLocations(slot_spacing, 0, n_slots, 1):
            Circle(boss_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-boss_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- break the boss rim edges -------------------------------------------
    boss_rim_edges = [
        e
        for e in bracket.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z - boss_z) < 1e-6
        and e.geom_type == GeomType.CIRCLE
        and abs(e.radius - boss_diameter / 2) < 1e-6
    ]
    chamfer(boss_rim_edges, chamfer_distance)

    # --- blind tapped holes -----------------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(bracket_length)) as hole_sketch:
        with GridLocations(slot_spacing, 0, n_slots, 1):
            Circle(boss_hole_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=-boss_hole_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = bracket.part
export_step(part, "output.step")
